rules.name: Agile
rules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Bravery Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to Morale Test rolls. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Deadly
rules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Dodge
rules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they aren't Fatigued, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls in melee against them.

rules.name: Enhanced Harassing
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Harassing, they may move by up to 6" from Harassing (instead of only 3").

rules.name: Enhanced Harassing Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Harassing. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Hit & Run
rules.description: If most models in this unit have Hit & Run, they may move by up to 6" from Hit & Run (instead of only 3").

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Furious Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Harassing
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Hit & Run
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Infiltrate
rules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

rules.name: Lacerate
rules.description: When attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Martial Prowess
rules.description: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being Fatigued when activated again). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

rules.name: Melee Shrouding
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for charging, that enemy unit gets -2" range to a min. of 6".

rules.name: Melee Shrouding Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Shrouding. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Melee Slayer
rules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Piercing Frenzy
rules.description: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking until the end of the game.

rules.name: Piercing Marksman
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

rules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Marksman. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

spells.name: Art of Pain
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 1 hit with AP(2) and Deadly(3).

spells.name: Fade in the Dark
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Stealth once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Holistic Suffering
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 9 hits.

spells.name: Psy-Adrenaline
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Enhanced Harassing once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Raiding Drugs
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Snake Bite
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Lacerate.
